title: Routine report
description: The built-in report of a routine created on a Clave server: what the run found, as items with a verdict each, and the facts worth keeping. A routine that wants its own page names a template folder instead.

items.description: What the run found or did, one entry each, in the order worth reading.

title.description: What this entry is about, in a few words.

verdict.description: ok: nothing to do; done: the run did something; attention: something is left for the person; failed: this part could not be done; note: information, no verdict.

detail.description: One or two sentences in plain words.

actions.description: What the person should do about it, one line each, with the command when there is one.

facts.description: Figures and values worth keeping with the run, by name: a count, a version, a date.
